requirements.requirement: The system must map backend certification status values to a normalized boolean state (certified=true, certified=false).
The system must convert backend certification status into a display label ('Board Certified' or 'Not Board Certified').
The system must normalize issuing authority names into a standardized display format (e.g., remove abbreviations or map to canonical names).
The system must ensure issuing authority text is human-readable and free of backend-specific codes or identifiers.
The system must format the score contribution value into a user-friendly string (e.g., percentage or points) consistent with the UI schema defined in S1.
The system must ensure the score contribution value is rounded or truncated according to UI display rules defined in the schema.
The system must output a structured object that conforms exactly to the schema defined in EVAL-P-BOARD-UX-S1.
The system must handle multiple certifications by selecting the primary certification or aggregating according to schema rules.
The system must preserve consistency between certification status and score contribution (e.g., non-certified providers must not display a positive contribution if prohibited by backend rules).
The system must handle missing certification status by defaulting to 'Unknown' and flagging the value as non-contributory.
The system must handle missing issuing authority by returning a null or placeholder value defined in the schema without breaking rendering.
The system must handle malformed or unexpected backend data formats by falling back to safe default display values.
The system must ensure all output fields required for rendering (status label, issuing authority, score contribution) are always present in the returned object.
The system must ensure that normalized values are deterministic for identical input data.
